resources.string: Double-tap volume down at the lowest media volume for 10 finer steps.

Volume Zoom watches only the volume keys. When media is at its lowest audible step, double-tap volume down to zoom into 10 extra, quieter steps (software attenuation of the media output). Volume up steps back out. No other input or screen content is read.
Android 13+ blocks accessibility for sideloaded apps until you open App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
Lower media volume to its last step, then double-tap volume down to zoom in. Each further down press is one fine step quieter; up steps back out. Down on the last fine step mutes.
Service: disabled. Enable \"Volume Zoom\" in accessibility settings.
Deepest fine step: −%1$d dB (%2$.1f dB per step)
